description: Load one or more installed servers' tools into this session by namespace; tools are prefixed by it (e.g. "gh_create_issue"). Pass `server` for one or `servers` for several. `tools: [...]` (single server only) advertises just those tools; the rest stay callable by name. Refused when YAW_MCP_MIN_COMPLIANCE is set and the server's grade is below it (ungraded always passes); the message names the grade and the variable.

servers.description: Multiple server namespaces to activate at once (e.g., ["gh", "slack"])

tools.description: Optional per-server tool filter (bare names, not namespace-prefixed). Only the listed tools surface in tools/list; the rest stay callable by name. Omit, or re-activate without it, for the full set. Single-server activation only.

name: mcp_connect_activate
